what: Measured band multipliers on stock-days with an 8-K filing, relative to an ordinary day (the ratio of root-mean-square stress-adjusted misses). These are GROUP values: use one of them, never a product with the event multiplier.
source: scripts/card/earnings_thread_test.py (results/2026-10-19/earnings_thread_full.out): 41,046 distinct stock-dates, pre-set rule PASSED (21 of 21 years positive). Item 7.01 from scripts/card/eightk_item_scan.py (results/2026-10-19/eightk_item_scan.out): 34,283 flagged days, passed its pre-set rule (20 of 21 years); a weak lead.
caveats: The 8-K table stores only the filing DATE: day 0 = the first trading day on or after it, day +1 = the next. A pre-market release reacts on day 0, an after-close release on day +1. If the time were known, the reaction-day multiplier would be about 3.5x (an inference from the two averages).

The ordinary-day group these were measured against still contained days with other 8-Ks and some unflagged pre-2004 earnings days, which pushes the ordinary scale up: the multipliers are conservative.
WIDTH ONLY. No sign is known for earnings days (the EPS-surprise test has not been run).
